description: This file defines the EmpLocations entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping employee location associations using Doctrine ORM annotations.

classes.name: EmpLocations
classes.description: Entity class representing employee location associations in the HRM system.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity associated with this location record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity for this location record.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the Location entity associated with this employee.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Associates a Location entity with this employee.
